audience: businesses in Greece that issue invoices and keep accounts in Oxygen Pelatologio

useCases.title: Find a contact by VAT number
useCases.text: Search contacts by VAT number, email or code. Open one contact to read its name, tax office and address.

useCases.title: Review issued invoices
useCases.text: List issued invoices by contact, date range or number. Open one invoice to read its line items, totals and myDATA status.

useCases.title: Look up products and VAT rates
useCases.text: List products and services with their net prices. Read the VAT rates to pick the right rate for a product.

useCases.title: Create a contact or a product
useCases.text: Create a customer or supplier. Create a product or service with a net sale price and a VAT rate from the rate list.

useCases.title: Issue an invoice after you confirm it
useCases.text: Confirm the customer, items and amounts first. Then pick a numbering sequence and a payment method. The invoice goes to myDATA, and the tool cannot undo it.
